description:
I'm Earl Mabry. I spent thirty-eight years with a rural electric co-op in southern
Ohio, first on the line crew, then reading and servicing meters. I stood in a lot of
basements looking at the box that decides what a family pays every month.
 
Now I'm retired, and I answer the questions people ask right before they spend real
money on power.
 
What you'll find here:
How much system you actually need, worked out in plain numbers
What gets oversold, and by how much
What every part in a setup does, in words that mean something
How to know when a quote is honest
Straight answers, no filler
 
I don't sell equipment, I'm not sponsored by anybody, and I'll never tell you a brand
name. I've got no stake in what you buy. That's the whole point.
 
New video most weeks. Subscribe if you'd rather understand it than be sold it.
